Territorial demarcation between India
and Bangladesh
*161. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the territorial
demarcation between India and Bangladesh
has not been completed and settled, so far;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to resolve the
issue and by when an amicable settlement
is expected to be arrived at?
Export of Basmati rice
*162. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DIS-
TRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have fixed minimum price for export of
Basmati rice to the European Union;
(b) if so, the estimated quantity of
Basmati rice to be exported during
2002-2003; and
(c) the other varieties of rice to be per-
mitted/promoted by Government for export
from Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh?
List of militant groups that infiltrated
into Jammu and Kashmir
*163. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have requested
the Government of Pakistan to furnish a
comprehensive list of militant groups
that infiltrated into Jammu and Kashmir
recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the reaction of the Govern-
ment of Pakistan thereto?
Procurement of paddy at MSP
*164. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DIS-
TRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) the paddy production in Andhra
Pradesh during the season of 2001;
(b) whether the entire paddy offered
in the State was procured by the Govern-
ment agencies at the Minimum Support
Price;

Availability of telephones
*165. SHRI C.O. POULOSE: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the availability of telephones per one
lakh population during the period of
1998—2001, State-wise; and
(b) whether Government have failed to
take Bihar and West Bengal into priority
list to improve the situation as these States
stand at the lowest in the country?
Amendment of CAT Act
*166. SHRI DINA NATH MISHRA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Central
Administrative Tribunal Act, 1985, is pro-
posed to be amended in the near future;
(b) if so, what prompted Government to
think for amendments; and
(c) what are the views of the State
Governments regarding functioning of the
Central Administrative Tribunals?
Revival of SSI units
*167. SHRI  A. VIJAYA  RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of SMALL SCALE IN-
DUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of small scale industrial
units closed-down during the last three years
in the country, State-wise;
(b) whether Government have taken any
measures to revive them;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Demands of Beedi workers
*168. DR. ALLADI  P. RAJKUMAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR be pleased
to state:
(a) whether a large number of Beedi
workers of the country owing allegiance to
all the major central trade unions took out a
protest procession in New Delhi on the 27th
November, 2001 in support of their de-
mands;
(b) if so, what are their demands; and
(c) what is Government's response
thereto?
Closure of SSIs
*169. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the Small Scale Industries closed
during the last three years;
(b) the number of workers rendered
jobless as a result thereof;
(c) the money of the banks and other
financial institutions blocked as a result
thereof; and
(d) whether Government have any plan
to assist this sector; if so, the details
thereof?

Misuse of KVIC's guest house in
Delhi
1164. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether KVIC has hired a house in
Neeti Bagh, New Delhi for being use as a
guest house at a very high rental price, but
in fact, it is being used as a residence by its
Chairman;
(b) if not, the number and names of
officials of KVIC who stayed in the said
guest house from the date, the said house
was taken on lease; and
(c) the amout paid by KVIC towards
monthly rent of the said house?
Implementation of Margin Money
Plan by KVIC in Rajasthan
1165. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
a written request from the State Government
of Rajasthan on 1st November, 2001 to
release an amount of Rs. 3.75 crore for
Margin Money to the KVI Board,
Rajasthan;
(b) whether the State Government has
also requested the Centre to solve some
problems arising in the implementation of
Margin Money Plan being operated by the
Khadi and Village Udyog Commission,
Bombay, at present; and
(c) if so, what action Government have
taken till date in this regard?
Production of power from atomic
energy
1166. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the percentage of electricity
produced from Atomic Power Plants;
(b) by when country would produce
10 per cent electricity needs from Atomic
Power Plants;
(c) whether Government would plan for
providing electricity from atomic energy as
recurring expenses are less; and
(d) the obstacles, if any?

WIN2\SESSION\5404RS 258
Modernisation of telecommunications
services
1167. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) what steps Government have taken,
so far,  for modernising telecommunication
services in the country to international level
and for incorporating state-of-the-art digital
technologies in the MTNL network;
(b) whether Government have decided
to cut registration charges for new
telephonic connections as well as for mobile
to mobile/STD calls rates as reported in
The Hindustan Times dated the 27th and
31st January, 2002; and
(c) if so, what are the details thereof
indicating orders in this regard issued by
the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India
for benefits of the common citizens?
Growth of IT exports
1168. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of  COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the growth of IT exports
during the current year;
(b) the export made in terms of rupees
during the said period; and
(c) the details of the steps being taken by
Government to boost the export prospects?
New companies in basic telephone
facilities
1169. SHRI P. N. SIVA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the new companies
functioning in the field of basic telephone
facilities; and
(b) the number of connections provided
under the private sector upto March 31,
2001, State-wise?
Blast of a telephone exchange in
Warangal
1170. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA RAO:
Will the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether People's War Group
militants blasted a telephone exchange in
Mallampalli in Warangal District in January,
2002;
(b) if so, whether any estimate of the
loss has been made;
(c) if so, the details of the same; and
(d) whether culprits have been identified
and arrested?
Mobile phone subscriber
1171. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the number of mobile phones
subscribers as on September, 2001 and what
are their number in the five Metro cities of
Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, Kolkata and
Chennai;
(b) what is the number of cellular
operators and their names in the above five
cities; and
(c) what is the growth rate of subscriber
base in the first six months of the current
financial year?

introduce e-bill post service in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the post offices in Karnataka
